senses.gloss: m. (מָסַר) informer, traitor (delivering Jews into the hands of the Roman government).
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 119a:6">B. Kam. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>ממון מ׳</he> the property of an informer.
<cite ref="Keritot 2b:5">Ker. 2ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 5a">B. Kam. 5ᵃ</cite> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מוסר</he>, corr. acc.); a. fr.—Pl. <he>מְסוֹרוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:15:6">Y. Sot. IX, end, 24ᶜ</cite>, a. e. <he>מפני המ׳</he> (studying Greek was forbidden) on account of the informers (whose familiarity with Greek tempted them to treason, v. Bab.
R. Hash. 17ᵃ המינין והמ׳ (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50) the heretics and the informers.—Fem. מָסוֹרָה.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 12:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XII</cite> <he>תהא אומתך מ׳ לך</he> (ed. Bub. <he>אומתיה מסיראה</he>, corr. acc.) may thy own people turn informer against thee; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 656:2">Yalk. Ps. 656</cite> (not <he>אימתך</he>).
